== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Great Ones are immensely powerful, supernatural entities that exist on a level above the [[Great Elders]]. They possess profound wisdom and are capable of intervening personally in worldly affairs, such as influencing the succession of thrones or communicating with individuals through [[dreams]]. While some [[Great Elders]] are viewed as alien and potentially malevolent, the Great Ones appear to operate with a sense of order, ensuring that bargains are honored and that certain cosmic or political structures remain functional. They have been known to influence the direction of humanity, and their will can dictate the restoration of natural order. Some individuals even carry physical fragments of a Great One.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Great Ones have a history of communication with mortals, having once spoken directly to [[Jyrine Tessella Marten|Jyrine]]. More recently, they have reached out to [[Jerri]] through various [[dreams]]. These entities possess the ability to inhabit human bodies in order to finish their intended work, and a Great One currently awaits a response from [[Jerri]]. While it is prophesied that the Great One will break the [[chains]], the entity ultimately ended a long time ago.}}
